purpose: Test whether the broad 100-race Frozen B1a performance and venue heterogeneity repeat on race-level-disjoint dates without retuning.
selection_rule: Extract each unique Kdreams meeting id and the day index already used by the seed 100-race universe.
For those same meetings only, enumerate other day indices 01, 02, 03 in ascending meeting-id/day/race-number order.
Exclude every exact seed-universe URL and every already-used day index for that meeting.
Use only the nine already-authoritatively-mapped venues: aomori 400m, yahiko 400m, gifu 400m, toyama 333.3m, matsuyama 400m, takeo 400m, kumamoto 400m, maebashi 335m, kawasaki 400m.
Probe PRE racecard parsing only; result and payout endpoints are forbidden during selection.
Take the first 100 candidates with complete mandatory Frozen B1a PRE fields; no result-dependent replacement or favorable-venue filtering.
Freeze all selected PRE inputs and predictions before dedicated result-page scoring.
If fewer than 100 complete PRE candidates exist, fail closed and report the maximum available set rather than changing the rule after seeing results.
independence_caveat: Race URLs/dates are disjoint from batch 1, but some races come from other days of the same meetings and may share riders/context. This is temporal replication, not fully independent-meeting replication.
